lockDistance.description: Lock reach: How close the player must be to the vehicle.

unlockChance.description: Door chance: Chance a lockpick opens a locked door.

hotwireChance.description: Hotwire chance: Chance the engine starts; the player then has the keys until leaving the server.

breakChance.description: Break chance: Chance the lockpick breaks when a try fails.

minigame.description: Minigame: Played before the progress bar. A lockpick that breaks in the lockpick game is used up. The chance above is still rolled after a won game: set it to 100 % to let the game decide alone.
